name: Blood Orange
siboNotes: Blood oranges are well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're naturally low FODMAP and don't feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Choose firm, heavy oranges with smooth skin for best quality
Store at room temperature for up to 1 week or refrigerate for longer storage
Roll on counter before peeling to make segmenting easier
Remove white pith which can be bitter
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Rich in anthocyanins (antioxidants that give red color)
